package_model_to_hub: upload a trained MBRL model with agent, config, and logs to a Hugging Face Hub repository
push_file_to_hub: push a model zip or mp4 file to an existing Hugging Face Hub repository
load_model_from_hub: download a saved model folder from a Hugging Face Hub repository to a local directory
create_agent_from_hub: create a SAC agent from config and checkpoint files in a Hugging Face Hub repository
evaluate_agent: evaluate an agent in a gym environment over multiple episodes and return episode rewards
